changes.title: Record verified TEST237 evidence
changes.text: Retain the exact TEST237 targeted, core, Android, visual, APK, application-ID and signature evidence without rebuilding or publishing unchanged source.

changes.title: Recover valid archive run identity
changes.text: Archive export and import now skip empty or invalid typed run IDs and use the first later valid logical identity, preventing header-only mislabelling.

commentary: TEST237 is the immediate previous produced APK and TEST231 remains the latest privately delivered fallback. Empty run-identity recovery requires exact before/after core evidence and one complete TEST238 application gate; no automatic delivery.
